annotations.title: Find Gearlist entries for a job

description: Find a short set of Gearlist entries whose own text shares the most words with a job you describe, spread across groups, quoting where each match appears. Matches are on words, so check each entry suits the job before suggesting it.

job.description: The job in plain words, for example 'test my web app in a real browser'. Common words such as 'my' or 'the' are ignored.

limit.description: How many entries to return, from 1 to 10. Default 6.

name: recommend_stack

access_notes.description: The setup, accounts, data, devices or payments it needs. Show this to the human.

group.description: The Gearlist group (category) the entry is in.

id.description: Stable Gearlist id. Pass it to get_gear.

source_checked.description: Date the source was last read, YYYY-MM-DD.

source_url.description: The public source that was read.

why_it_fits.description: Where the job's words appear in this entry.

field.description: The entry field the words come from, as named in resources.json.

quote.description: Text copied word for word from that field, holding the matched words.

words.description: The entry's own words that matched the job.

match.description: found: each item has at least half of the job's words, and at least two when the job has two or more, in its name, id, group, description or audience. none: no entry does.

next_step.description: What to do with the result.

total_matches.description: Entries that fit the job, before the limit.

words.description: The job's words that were looked for, after common words were dropped and word endings trimmed.

title: Find Gearlist entries for a job
